description.text: The fifth set of the EX series, released on 14 June 2004 with 102 cards, 101 numbered and a secret Groudon, and two theme decks, Forest Guardian and WishMaker. Its hidden legends are Regirock, Regice and Registeel, joined by Jirachi and a Dark Celebi from the film Pokémon 4Ever, and with it every third-generation Pokémon but Deoxys had a card. It was the first EX set without e-Reader dot codes, and its Exploud was the first card with four attacks.
